_comment: Optional providers, merged into gateway_config.sample.json only when an API key is set (PRISM_OPENROUTER_API_KEY). Without a key this file is ignored. Models are appended to the END of the named alias chains, so they serve traffic only after alpha and beta have failed. model_ids maps Prism's logical names to the provider's own model ids. probe=false: the health prober would spend real, billed requests every 3 s.
